source: USDA FoodData Central — SR Legacy and Foundation Foods. Works of the US Government, in the public domain. A small number of generic composite dishes are estimated from their ingredient lists rather than taken from a single USDA record.
notes: Every value is per 100 g, or per 100 ml where basisUnit is "ml". A micronutrient key is present only when a defensible value exists: an absent key means "unknown", never "zero". Energy is checked against Atwater 4/4/9, falling back to the EU fibre-adjusted calculation (fibre at 2 kcal/g) for fibrous foods and to a 15 kcal absolute bound for very low-energy plant foods; ethanol (7 kcal/g) and acetic acid (3.5 kcal/g) are accounted for separately because no macronutrient field carries them. No brand names or trademarks appear anywhere in this file.
